## Purpose

Explain the specific defect, research-methodology improvement, or maintenance
change. Link an issue when one exists.

## Validation

- [ ] Tests covering changed behavior were added or updated
- [ ] Local command and result are recorded (do **not** claim hosted CI passed if blocked)
- [ ] Scientific hypothesis/oracle and cost units remain explicit
- [ ] Frozen dataset/results/provenance files were not modified without a reviewed release procedure
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, or unnecessary binary artifacts added
- [ ] Third-party copyright and dataset terms reviewed for new material
- [ ] README / docs updated where public interfaces or assumptions changed

## Evidence

Commands run, observed outputs, commit IDs, and remaining limitations:

## Release impact

Indicate whether this PR changes numerical claims, test contracts, source
reproducibility, or private submission artifacts. If it changes a theorem
assumption, request independent mathematical review.
